text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O and I have been hard at
work during Tracen
Academy's summer
camp, and we've finally reached the last
day.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh... What a beautiful day! I can feel
the sun's energy pouring into
me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Now, let's get down to business!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
As the model of punctuality, I never waste
time! Not even a
millisecond!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I just can't wait for tonight!
♪ It's been so
long since I've been to a
festival. Do you
think they'll have candy apples?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
They should, right? Although I prefer
candied fruit slices myself! You
can eat
them in just one bite.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: A festival, eh... I had no idea.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I was just about to suggest the same
thing!
Hehe, we're on the same
wavelength!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
All right, it's decided! We're going to a
festival after this! Let this be
extra
motivation for today's training!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Once we finish our day of training on the
beach, Sakura Bakushin O
and I head back
to prepare for the festival.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Chatter, chatter...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Is everyone going to the festival?
Uh... it might be a bit
crowded.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
A bit? Now that's an understatement... We
better stick together.
Don't want to get
lost.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing all the Umamusume getting ready
to go to the festival, I start
to get nervous.
What if I lose Sakura Bakushin O in the
crowd...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Apologies for the wait, Trainer! I'm all
ready to go!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Okay, what is it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Of course! As class representative, safety
is always my top priority!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Right, communication is an important tool
for anyone, but especially
the class
representative! Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yup, I have it in my bag—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: AHHH! My bag! I almost forgot it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: D-don't worry! I'll be right back!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O's absentmindedness does not inspire confidence...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Whoooa! Look at all these stalls!
The food!
The festival dance!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
This brings back so many memories... My
parents were always so
impressed by my
skills in the shooting and fishing games.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, this is sooo exciting!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That does it,
we're visiting ALL the stalls!
Let's start over there!
Ready, set...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: BAKUSHIIIN!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My efforts to stop her are in vain, and
before I know it, she
disappears into the
crowd...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the festival venue as crowded as it
is,
I soon lose track of Sakura
Bakushin O
completely.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As planned, I try calling her cell phone,
but all I hear is an automated message
saying she can't be reached...
I should find the organizers
and—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: TRAAAIIINEEEERRR!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Can you hear me?! I'm over here, Trainer!
Where are you?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I whip my head around at the sound of
Bakushin O's voice. All I see is
more
people, but I head in the direction of her
calls.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hello, hello?! Trainer, answer me!
Trai—wait, why's my screen black?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Traaaiiineeerrr! Where are youuuu?! My
cell phone isn't working!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A black screen...
Judging by the fact that I
haven't received any calls,
that can only
mean one thing...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Ah, now that you mention it,
it's off!
Wait—Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness you found me! I thought
I'd lost you for good!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Of course I did!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The class representative always keeps her
promises!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I trust you, Trainer! I know you
only have my best interests at
heart!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Just like I always keep my fellow students
in mind!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Agreed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Considering the crowd, I was worried you
might have been hurt!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
But it seems that didn't happen...
to either
of us!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And now, we have been reunited! And it
feels so good!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'd say we're a winning combination if
there ever was one! I can't wait to see
where we go in the future! Here's to us,
Trainer! Put 'er there!
Bakushin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I shake Sakura Bakushin O's hand as the
festival music plays on. We
still have room
to grow, but I can't wait to see what this
so-called "winning combination" can do.
